proposed.explanation: Confuses contractor obligations with architect professional services; the contractor's labor disputes are not architect professional failures. Acts of God are natural disasters beyond anyone's control and not covered by professional indemnity; insurance covers only the architect's professional errors. An owner's business decision to halt a project is not an architect professional error; professional indemnity covers only the architect's design, specification, or supervision failures. Design errors, specification mistakes, and inadequate supervision are professional failures covered by the architect's professional indemnity insurance. Design defects, specification errors, and inadequate supervision are architect professional failures covered by indemnity insurance.
